description: Presentations, interviews, and community spotlights with local DEF CON Groups coordinators around the world during DEF CON 26.

talks.title: Spotlight on DC010 Beijing with Jun Li
talks.teaser: DEF CON Groups ambassador Jayson Street interviews Jun Li, founder of DC010 Beijing, discussing community growth and technical events in China.

talks.title: Spotlight on DC617 Boston with April Wright
talks.teaser: April Wright shares how DC617 Boston organizes local community meetings, hands-on hardware hacking, and collaborative learning.

talks.title: Spotlight on DC2744 Garden Route South Africa
talks.teaser: Jayson Street interviews Adrian from DC2744 in Garden Route, South Africa, exploring regional infosec community challenges and initiatives.

talks.title: 3D Printing Techniques for Hackers
talks.teaser: Dr3t from DC719 Colorado Springs delivers a detailed technical presentation on 3D printing workflows, filament tuning, and custom hacker jewelry design.
